levels.name: 熔焰前夜
levels.subtitle: 充能与短冲首发 · 双径交替压境
levels.subtitle_en: Chargers and Shield Generators debut · Alternating pressure from two lanes
levels.story_intro: 熔焰前夜热浪扑面，冲锋怪和护盾发生器第一次在双路上交替施压。蛋蛋左右两边来回跑，决心哪边都不漏怪。
levels.story_intro_en: Eve of Embers glows hot as chargers and shield generators debut with alternating pressure from two lanes. Eggy runs left and right, determined to leak nothing on either side.
levels.story_outro: 前夜过去了，双路防线稳稳立住。
levels.story_outro_en: The eve passes, and the twin line stands firm.

levels.name: 灰烬双径
levels.subtitle: 召唤双线施压 · 东西两道不可偏废
levels.subtitle_en: Summoners pressure both lanes · Neither entrance can be neglected
levels.story_intro: 灰烬双径两处入口同时被召唤怪盯上，哪边松懈哪边就会被突破。蛋蛋把兵力对半分开，两边都留好后手。
levels.story_intro_en: Ashen Twin Paths sees summoners pressure both lanes, where either neglected entrance will break. Eggy splits forces evenly and keeps backup on both sides.
levels.story_outro: 双径都保住了，灰烬里开出了小小的花。
levels.story_outro_en: Both paths survive, and small flowers bloom in the ash.

levels.name: 岩浆回廊
levels.subtitle: 抗性与治疗结阵 · 铁壁波考验穿透
levels.subtitle_en: Resistants and Healers entrench · Iron-wall waves test your penetration
levels.story_intro: 岩浆回廊里抗性怪和治疗怪扎下根来，像铁壁一样考验穿透力。蛋蛋换上穿透和减速组合，一点点凿开缺口。
levels.story_intro_en: Magma Corridor entrenches resistant foes and healers like an iron wall testing penetration. Eggy swaps to penetration and slowing combos to carve an opening bit by bit.
levels.story_outro: 回廊的铁壁被凿穿了，岩浆的光也变得温柔起来。
levels.story_outro_en: The iron wall breaks, and even the magma glow softens.

levels.name: 焦谷三岔
levels.subtitle: 三岔口空地齐袭 · 飞行与短冲同压
levels.subtitle_en: Three forks under air and ground raids · Fliers and Chargers press together
levels.story_intro: 焦谷三岔分出三条路，空中地上一起突袭，飞行兵和冲锋怪结伴压来。蛋蛋抬头看天又低头看地，防空和地面一个都不落下。
levels.story_intro_en: Scorched Fork Valley splits into three forks under air and ground raids, with fliers and chargers pressing together. Eggy watches sky and ground at once, missing neither anti air nor ground defense.
levels.story_outro: 三岔全部守住，山谷里响起开心的呼喊。
levels.story_outro_en: All three forks hold, and happy shouts fill the valley.

levels.name: 雷暴焦土
levels.subtitle: 虫潮短冲浪涌 · 中段强度陡增
levels.subtitle_en: Swarm tides and Charger surges · Mid-chapter intensity spikes
levels.story_intro: 雷暴焦土虫群如潮，冲锋怪一波接一波，双线强度陡然升高。蛋蛋提前攒好群攻塔，等潮水来了迎头痛击。
levels.story_intro_en: Storm Scorched Ground rolls swarm tides and charger surges with mid chapter intensity spiking on two lanes. Eggy saves splash towers early to meet the tide head on.
levels.story_outro: 潮水退去，焦土上留下了一条干净的防线。
levels.story_outro_en: The tide recedes, leaving a clean line on the scorched land.

levels.name: 风暴隘口
levels.subtitle: 召唤双径接力 · 治疗核心护航
levels.subtitle_en: Summoners relay down both lanes · Healer cores escort the horde
levels.story_intro: 风暴隘口两条路上召唤怪接力不断，还有治疗核心一路护送。蛋蛋算好接力点，在交接处设下埋伏。
levels.story_intro_en: Storm Narrows relays summoners down both lanes with healer cores escorting the horde. Eggy counts the relay points and sets ambushes where they hand off.
levels.story_outro: 接力被打断了，隘口的风也小了下来。
levels.story_outro_en: The relay breaks, and winds ease at the narrows.

levels.name: 熔核裂隙
levels.subtitle: 分裂体浪潮 · 治疗链拖垮火力
levels.subtitle_en: Splitter tides · Healer chains grind down your firepower
levels.story_intro: 熔核裂隙张开三条裂缝，分裂潮涌个不停，治疗链还一直在磨火力。蛋蛋把高伤塔分散开，三条路一起开火。
levels.story_intro_en: Molten Core Rift opens three lanes of splitter tides while healer chains grind down firepower. Eggy spreads heavy hitters wide to fire on all three roads at once.
levels.story_outro: 裂隙的三条缝都被堵住，熔核的光暗了下去。
levels.story_outro_en: All three cracks plug shut, and the core glow dims.

levels.name: 灰烬王庭
levels.subtitle: 铁壁强化共振 · 双召唤轮替施压
levels.subtitle_en: Iron walls with support resonance · Twin Summoners apply pressure in turn
levels.story_intro: 灰烬王庭铁壁林立，支援怪互相呼应，两拨召唤怪轮流施压。蛋蛋稳住心神，先断呼应，再逐个击破。
levels.story_intro_en: Court of Ash raises iron walls with support resonance while twin summoners press in turn. Eggy steadies his mind, cuts their link first, then breaks them one by one.
levels.story_outro: 王庭的灰落定了，铁壁也被推倒。
levels.story_outro_en: Ash settles in the court, and the iron walls fall.

levels.name: 风暴穹顶
levels.subtitle: 狂暴风暴与重装 · 双径极限绞杀
levels.subtitle_en: Rager storms and heavy armor · Both lanes squeeze to the limit
levels.story_intro: 风暴穹顶下狂暴风暴裹着重甲怪，两条路同时被挤到极限。蛋蛋把减速铺满全场，让风暴慢下来再打。
levels.story_intro_en: Storm Dome brews rager storms and heavy armor that squeeze both lanes to the limit. Eggy blankets the field with slowing so the storm slows before it breaks.
levels.story_outro: 穹顶的风暴散了，双线防线依然完整。
levels.story_outro_en: The dome storm clears, and both lanes remain whole.

levels.name: 余烬王座
levels.subtitle: 终幕双王分道 · 全机制会师决战
levels.subtitle_en: Grand finale · Twin Bosses split the lanes as every mechanic converges
levels.story_intro: 余烬王座是第四章的大终局，两位首领分走两条路，所有手段在此交汇，三条防线一起告急。蛋蛋握紧村长给的哨子说，这一次绝不后退。
levels.story_intro_en: Throne of Embers is the grand finale of chapter four, with twin Bosses splitting the lanes as every mechanic converges across three lines. Eggy grips the whistle from the chief and vows no retreat this time.
levels.story_outro: 王座的余烬熄灭了，双线防守画上圆满句号。
levels.story_outro_en: Embers of the throne fade, closing the two front defense in triumph.
